messages:
samir: quick run summary from this morning — continuous-batcher sweep across regions for gemma-8b (int8) + adaptive cohort routing. posting raw numbers, want eyeballs on fairness and kernel routing.
perf-bot: results uploaded: https://perf.redwood/reports/2332109876 — CSV + png charts
maria: nice. what's the config? window / max_tokens / cohorts?
samir: baseline: batch_window=10ms, max_batch_tokens=2048, cohort routing: simple latency-pref fallback, kernel set auto. ran apac(h100), eu(a100), us(g8x).
ashley: can you paste the top-line p95/p50 and qps per region?
samir: pasted below (copied from perf CSV):

```
region,gpu,p50_ms,p95_ms,qps,avg_batch_size,p90_batch_size
apac,h100,18,46,210,6.2,12
eu,a100,24,78,160,4.8,9
us,g8x,33,120,95,3.1,7
```

samir: also saw high tail in us, kernel autotune picked legacy-attn for g8x which seems worse for long context.
ken: interesting. what was seq len distribution? maybe g8x hit long sequences more.
samir: seqLen median=512, 95th=1500; us traffic has heavier long-context (~20% > 1k tokens)
maria: that explains larger p95. did you try lowering max_batch_tokens to reduce token-multiplexing on g8x?
samir: yes — ab test with max_batch_tokens=1024, window=8ms for us only. new numbers:

```
region,gpu,p50_ms,p95_ms,qps,avg_batch_size
us,g8x (tuned),28,92,112,4.2
```

ashley: qps up and tail down — avg batch size increased though? odd.
samir: batch size distribution shifted: fewer huge token batches, more balanced batches -> better throughput but still tail from long single-request pops.
ken: what about kernel routing? force new-attn-v2 on g8x in that tuned run?
samir: yes for the tuned run I forced new-attn-v2. that seems to reduce compute time for long contexts but has higher memory pressure; a couple of runs OOM'ed at >2k tokens so we kept max_batch_tokens=1024.
perf-bot: attached heatmap: https://perf.redwood/images/2332109876/heatmap.png
maria: any fairness metrics across cohorts? we wanted max 10% variance across tenant cohorts for Dedicated tier.
samir: computed cohort p95 delta across 5 simulated tenants (cohorts A-E) with the default routing:

```
cohort,p95_ms
A,44
B,48
C,72
D,51
E,46
```

samir: C is the outlier — mostly long-context chat bot.
ashley: can we apply cohort-aware priority decay so long-context tenant gets slightly lower priority or smaller max_batch_tokens?
ken: idea: route long-context requests to a separate lane with higher preemption and dedicated kernel (new-attn-v2) and fallback to legacy when memory constrained.
devops-bot: created experiment branch: cohort-lane + preemptive-routing (job id: exp-2332109876-1)
perf-bot: ran exp-2332109876-1 with cohort-lane enabled in eu+us, results:

```
region,scenario,p50_ms,p95_ms,qps
us,baseline,33,120,95
us,cohort-lane,30,78,105
eu,baseline,24,78,160
eu,cohort-lane,23,65,168
```

perf-bot: tail improved (~35%) for the heavy cohort and overall qps bumped in both regions.
maria: that's promising. any quality/regression signal from quantization int8 vs fp16?
samir: ran evals on 2k prompt set, measured rouge/semantic-sim delta between fp16 baseline and int8 quant: mean sim drop = 0.003 (std 0.01) — not material but watch for dialog politeness edge cases.
ashley: we should add a small eval set of long-context turn-taking prompts — int8 sometimes repeats tokens for long context.
samir: noted, will add. also tested int4 toy config on apac/h100: huge perf win but quality delta ~0.02 on sim metric, not acceptable for now.
ken: what's next action? short list?
maria: 1) roll out cohort-lane in canary for Dedicated and monitor cohort p95 variance 2) enable kernel override policy: prefer new-attn-v2 for >1k tokens on g8x/h100, fallback to legacy when mem low 3) tighten max_batch_tokens to 1024 for g8x by default 4) expand long-context evals for int8 artifacts
ashley: add SLO alert: if any cohort p95 exceeds global p95 by >40% fire pager for infra-oncall (we've seen C at ~72 vs global 60)
devops-bot: created ticket INFRA-4592 for kernel override and INFRA-4593 for cohort canary rollout
samir: I'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow 9am PT to go over canary plan and dashboard thresholds. cc @maria @ken @ashley
maria: thanks — I'll prep the eval prompt set and a short regression dashboard
ken: lgtm
ashley: :+1:
samir: thanks everyone, attaching few commands used for reproducibility:

```
# run sweep
rbench sweep --model gemma-8b --quant int8 --regions apac,eu,us \
  --gpus h100,a100,g8x --batch_window 10ms --max_batch_tokens 2048 \
  --cohort-sim tenants=5 --save results/2332109876.csv

# tuned run for g8x
rbench run --model gemma-8b --region us --gpu g8x \
  --batch_window 8ms --max_batch_tokens 1024 --kernel new-attn-v2 --quant int8
```

samir: ping if you want the raw traces, I uploaded them to /mnt/perf/2332109876/trace.tar.gz
